Variants.Content: Great Wyk Island is the largest island in the Iron Islands. It is located in the northern part of the archipelago and has many rocky cliffs and narrow harbours. Ironborn families such as the Gubler family occupy the island separately, and Warhammer Point is an important stronghold; it belongs to the Iron Islands, and the barren land and long coast make longships, fishing, mining and raiding traditions jointly shape local life.
Entry Great Wyk Local families also relied on salt fish, ore, barren fields, sheltered anchorages, and longships to return home; if any road, well, or dock failed, the price would fall first on them.

Entry Great Wyk A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Great Wyk They care about salt fish, ore, barren fields, sheltered anchorages, and the return of longships. They also look at whether seeds are left after collecting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
